name: triz
description: Deterministic, read-only TRIZ knowledge: the 39 engineering parameters, 40 inventive principles, and the Altshuller contradiction matrix with fail-closed blank cells — plus stage-based tool routing and blinded MATRIZ case evals. Agents cite looked-up principles, never recalled ones.

environment_variables.name: TRIZ_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Directory containing the TRIZ JSON data files; only needed when running outside the packaged layout.

environment_variables.name: TRIZ_GRAPH
environment_variables.description: Optional path to a project OTSM Network of Problems JSON for the triz_graph tool.

environment_variables.name: TRIZ_REGISTRY
environment_variables.description: Optional path to a project contradiction registry JSON for purpose verification.

tools.name: triz_parameter
tools.description: Get a canonical TRIZ engineering parameter (1-39); omit id to list all.

tools.name: triz_principle
tools.description: Get a canonical inventive principle (1-40); omit id to list all.

tools.name: triz_matrix
tools.description: Look up a contradiction-matrix cell; blank and diagonal cells fail closed.

tools.name: triz_resolve
tools.description: Look up a cell and expand its parameters and principles.

tools.name: triz_tool_catalog
tools.description: List the 34 routed TRIZ tools, optionally by stage.

tools.name: triz_route
tools.description: Select candidate TRIZ tools by stage and observed problem signals.

tools.name: triz_evals
tools.description: Return the neutral lookup and reasoning evaluation suites.

tools.name: triz_graph
tools.description: Optional: analyse a project OTSM Network of Problems graph.

tools.name: triz_purpose
tools.description: Optional: inspect the invariant and purpose gate of one graph node.
